posts.name: OddballPaladin
posts.cooked:
I do prefer the podcast version rather than the raw video because I listed to the audio at 1.25-1.5 speed. Granted, that makes Adam sound even MORE hyper at times, but it doesn't feel like a slog.

The Nemesis discussion makes me think: have folks done house rules that have alternate Nemesis effects? Like Adam said, it's just an icon, and the rules aren't on the cards themselves, so it's easy to use or ignore, but that also means it would be easy enough to modify.

posts.name: dpt
posts.cooked:
""Powerhound2000"":

Feels like adding tokens to recall the nemesis symbol being there kind of defeats the purpose of having the nemesis symbol on the card.

The point is to put something that isn’t usually there. If you always put it on the card, yes, it’s pointless, but introducing an element that is only sometimes there will make your mind notice it.
